description: List the records (entries) of a data model, by the model's id or slug. Supports filtering (per key: scalar equality, $in, $gte/$lte, $regex), sort, and pagination. Each record includes its full data, so you can find a record by a field value (e.g. sku) without extra lookups. Each record carries `url`: its live storefront link, built by the server from the model's urlPattern and the site's public site URL. Use it whenever you link to a record and never build a storefront URL yourself (not from a slug, not from the site address). When url is null or missing, say why instead of guessing: the model has no urlPattern (set it with update_model), the model is not delivered (deliveryAccess none, or it is the login model), the site has no public site URL, or the record - or one it links to - is unpublished.

filter.description: Filter on record data fields (or "status"). Supported per key: scalar equality {sku: "ABC-1"}, {"$in": [...]}, {"$gte"/"$lte": ...} ranges, {"$regex": "term", "$options": "i"}. Anything else is rejected.

locale.description: Language for translatable fields, e.g. 'pl'. Their values come back as plain strings in that language, and a filter on one matches that language. Defaults to the workspace's default language.

modelIdOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug (from list_models)

name: list_records
title: List records
